Boot ID changed from 03408ac4-bfe4-4151-98bd-1966b0a205af to de8a57cc-ed15-4b69-b3e3-11e75a44e947; listener, prior data, and fresh ingestion recovered.

commands.command:
install -d -m 0755 -o root -g root /var/log/inventory
cat > /etc/rsyslog.d/20-inventory-collector.conf <<'ANTRIEB_EOF'
module(load="imtcp")

ruleset(name="inventory_remote") {
    if ($fromhost-ip == '10.100.223.11' and $programname == 'inventory') then {
        action(type="omfile"
               file="/var/log/inventory/node2.log"
               fileOwner="root"
               fileGroup="root"
               fileCreateMode="0640"
               dirCreateMode="0755")
        stop
    }
}
